'''Hangar bay G-12''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] aboard the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Subjugator (Victory-class)|''Subjugator'']]. The hangar was the launch bay for [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kolaff]]'s [[command shuttle]].
